title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-M BANANA Perpetual Contract With Up to 50x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience,  Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M BANANA Perpetual Contract  at  2024-08-15 02:00 (UTC) ,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M BANANA Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract BANANAUSDT Launch Time 2024-08-15 02:00 (UTC)  Underlying Asset Banana Gun (BANANA) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the BANANAUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-08-15 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-08-15 08:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-06-18 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-06-18 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned Futures contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the BANANAUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The BANANAUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
